name: How do I choose a reputable water damage restoration company in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reputable water damage restoration company in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a water damage restoration company in the Bay Area, look for certifications such as IICRC (Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification). Ensure they are licensed, insured, and have experience with projects similar to yours. Check their local reviews and ask for references. A good company, like City Dweller, LLC, will offer a clear assessment, transparent pricing, and comprehensive service, including working with your insurance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a company with IICRC certification, proper licensing, insurance, strong local reviews, and comprehensive service offerings. Ask for references.
